correctness.rationale: Schulz's proof bounds the S2 part by an explicit n-th power of a logarithm, while each of finitely many S1 subspaces substitutes away one exponential term. Strengthening the same induction quantitatively gives O((log H)^n), and the finite piecewise-affine reduction gives the M-ary result. The carry-free base-B construction proves sharpness.
